payload.notes:
Gemma 4 26B A4B instruction Q8 GGUF on one Intel Arc Pro B70 via llama.cpp SYCL/XPU. Short-prompt sustained-decode shape: prompt_mode=long produced actual 75 prompt tokens and exactly 512 generated tokens on every repeat. Validation: standard chat canary 96 repeats x 4 cases = 384/384 pass with REASONING=off. Throughput uses server-reported usage.completion_tokens after TTFT. This supersedes the prior 42.15 tok/s natural-stop/default-prompt result for pure sustained decode rate, while using a different prompt/output shape. No speculative decode; MTP n=2/4/8 smokes were slower. Evidence: https://github.com/steveseguin/b70-optimization-lab/blob/main/results/gemma4-26b-a4b-q8-b70/README.md and data/gemma4-q8-gpu0-currentbest-longprompt-deep-20260623T0945/summary.json.
